notes.title: Patch #3 available
notes.notes:
Hello,
A minor patch is now available (v. 1.0.43). It includes a fix for some graphical glitches in the ending cutscene. I hope you will enjoy it and thanks for playing!

Patch notes

Fixes:

 Ending cutscene graphical glitches.


Updates and changes:

 Ending credits text updated.

notes.title: Patch #2 available
notes.notes:
Hello,
The second patch is here (v. 1.0.42). It includes a fix for a glitch which was overlooked that unfortunately halted game progression. Your game progress is safe and you are clear to proceed in the game from where you left off. I hope you will enjoy it and thanks for playing!

Patch notes

Fixes:

 Unable to enter the old factory.
 Stamina meter not visible in 3rd person view when running.
 Shader errors.
 AI and pathfinding adjustments.

notes.title: Patch #1 available
notes.notes:
Hello,
The first patch is here (v. 1.0.41). It includes some remedies for issues raised from player feedback that has flown under the radar during Beta tests, and also some general gameplay improvements for a better experience. I hope you will enjoy it and thanks for playing!

Patch notes

Fixes:

Compass showing incorrect northern direction.
Deers not receiving damage from rifle.
Map location X markers adjusted for more accurate position.
Tooltip position adjustments in inventory.
Rotation limit on intro first person camera inside the car.
Disappearing/poping objects in the cabin.
Missing objects in the cabin.
AI and pathfinding fixes.
UI elements positions in inventory.

Additions and updates:

You will now need to first get the handgun before being able to acquire the rifle.
Finding ammunition objective now auto-completes if ammunition is already in inventory.
Tooltip on equipment items.
Hint in inventory.
Increased refresh time on ammo stash in the cabin.
Empty hands on hotkey ESC or Backspace key press (previously only Backspace).
Deer animations fine tuning.
Foggy weather effect improved.
Lighting updates in the cabin cellar.
